limitations: Early-day overlapping surveillance, not continuous or exhaustive.
No age/severity restriction; explicit adult severe burden/comorbidity/negative-result query. No result means evidence gap, not absence of burden or efficacy.
PubMed publication/entry/modification and registry posting dates differ; newly encountered does not mean newly published.
Preprint lexical screen can miss synonyms; other servers not comprehensively enumerated.
WHO query export unavailable; CTIS SPA returns no interpreted protocol record; national/worldwide registry coverage incomplete.
Full registry history and comprehensive publisher/Crossmark clearance not performed.
No participant data, stories, full abstracts or papers retained; original summaries and public metadata only.
